name: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company,Inc.
summary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc., formed in 1918 with its base in Tokyo, Japan, makes and distributes basic and specialty chemicals and high-performance functional materials. Its Natural Gas Chemicals segment produces methanol, organic chemicals and life science products and engages in natural gas and oil development. The company also performs testing, analysis and advisory work on environmental monitoring and chemical product safety.
